purpose: Require or describe action without delay.
keywords: If you notice anything abnormal, stop using it immediately.
On hearing the alarm, everyone evacuated immediately.
I will contact you immediately once confirmation is obtained.
restrictions: Often used for urgent responses, procedures, or immediate consequences.
mistake: It sounds firmer and more official than すぐ.
